caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, composed of two main sections. The upper, rounded part of the bonnet is straw-colored, textured to suggest a woven material. Attached to the base of this straw-colored section is a soft, draping fabric that is light blue in color, extending outward and downward to form a protective skirt around the edges. Two long, narrow blue ties made of the same material as the lower section hang down from the sides of the bonnet. The background of the drawing is an unadorned, neutral off-white or cream color. There is a small handwritten text or signature in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Straw Bonnet
